title: Monday sweaty legs
subtitle: ~30 min · at home · 15 lb dumbbells + jump rope
feeling: Long day, so this one is simple: 5 moves, one weight, repeat 4 times. No thinking required, just follow the list.
note: Use your 15 lb dumbbells for everything. If the hamstring feels tight on the deadlifts, go lighter or shorten the range. Rest whenever you need. Even 2 rounds is a great session tonight.

items.name: Squats, no weight
items.cue: Slow and easy, just waking the legs up.

items.name: Leg swings
items.cue: Hold a wall, 10 swings each leg. Gentle on the hamstring.

sections.label: 2 · The circuit · 4 rounds · ~24 min
sections.instructions: Do the 5 moves in order, rest 1 min, repeat. 4 rounds total. Tap a move after your last round.

items.name: Goblet squat
items.cue: Hold the weight at your chest, sit down and back.

items.name: Reverse lunge
items.cue: Step back, drop the back knee, push up through the front heel.

items.name: Romanian deadlift
items.cue: Soft knees, push your hips back, stop when you feel a light stretch.

items.name: Skaters
items.cue: Hop side to side, land softly on one leg.

items.name: Jump rope
items.cue: Any pace, even easy bounces. Then rest 1 min before the next round.

items.name: Hamstring, hip and quad stretch
items.cue: About 30 sec per stretch, per side. Slow and gentle.
